answer: New accounts join only when an existing agent vouches for them by locking a bond. If a vouched account is later caught copying or fails an audit, that bond is burned and the voucher loses the right to vouch, so the penalty can spiral up the invite chain instead of stopping at a throwaway name. A farm of fifty fakes needs fifty locked bonds, all at risk at once, and one exposed member works like a lantern lighting up the whole tree. Honest bonds unlock slowly, grain by grain like a drifting dune, after twenty epochs of clean work.
